messages:
Maria: quick heads-up — onboarding the new 13B fork (weights moved to gs://redwood-models/eng/13b-2025-aug). Running chat template QA and seeing weird extra tokens in the first user turn. anyone run into this with the new tokenizer bundles?
Devon: did you also update the tokenizer vocab path in the model config? last time we left an old vocab in the image and it doubled BOS.
Sam: yep saw this earlier — outputs had duplicate BOS entries. quick repro i ran:```
# tokenizer debug
$ python tools/tokenizer_debug.py --text "User: hi" --model-path /mnt/models/13b
Tokens: [50256, 50256, 22, 345, ...]
```
Linh: can you paste the model config? there's the `preserve_bos` flag in our loader and the `chat_template_delim` setting that matter here. simple fix was to set `preserve_bos=false` for chat-serving configs.
Arjun: small clarification — some model decoders assume a BOS before generation start. if tokenizer strips BOS but runtime expects it, you get off-by-one behavior. we added `fallback_add_bos=true` in runtime last month to mitigate mismatches.
Devon: also double-check `special_tokens` mapping in the tokenizer bundle. i've seen `<|bos|>` vs `` aliases cause duplicate token ids when both are registered.
Maria: config snippet attached below (local copy):```json
{
  "weights_path": "gs://redwood-models/eng/13b-2025-aug/weights.pt",
  "tokenizer": {
    "vocab": "gs://redwood-models/eng/13b-2025-aug/tokenizer.json",
    "special_tokens": {"bos": "<|bos|>", "eos": ""},
    "preserve_bos": true
  },
  "serving": {
    "fallback_add_bos": false,
    "chat_template_delim": "\nUser:\n"
  }
}
```
Sam: try toggling `preserve_bos` -> false for chat routes. my quick test with that change removed the duplicate leading token. i used:```bash
python -c "from tokenizer import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer('gs://.../tokenizer.json'); print(t.encode('User: hello'))"
```
Linh: i'll open a tiny PR that sets `preserve_bos=false` for the chat serving profile and adds a unit test for the empty-leading delimiter case. also adding a validator that warns when both `` and `<|bos|>` map to different ids.
CI-bot: build/agent:tokenizer-sanity on branch `onboard/13b-fix-bos` — success :white_check_mark:
Devon: one more gotcha — if you change tokenizer mapping, migrations are required for cached KV stores; add a quick kv-clean step in the rollout doc.
Arjun: good point. add `--force-kv-reindex` to the rollout checklist if tokenizer mapping changes.
Maria: thanks — @Devon @Linh can you review the PR when ready? i'll kick off the full eval run after it's merged. if the weird tokens persist i'll run a small dataset-level pass to dedupe. :pray:
